title: Expected distribution
view: Shared front-view base (visuals/distribution_bases/front): skeleton on the left, grey body on the right, patient's right on the image left; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: A PENG block targets the articular branches to the anterior hip capsule; it shades the hip joint in bone and no skin.
claims: Bone only: femoral head and neck with the acetabular rim (anterior capsule of the hip joint; record anatomy).
No skin is shaded: PENG is designed to spare the cutaneous branches and the quadriceps motor branch (record anatomy; NYSORA).
Right-sided block, patient's right on the image left (house laterality); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
